Home.heroTitle: The simplest way to sell your property in Switzerland
Home.heroSubtitle: Rely on ImmoAdvisor: choose only the services you really need, with transparent pricing and no strings attached.
Home.howItWorksText: Browse the available services — listing, photography, documentation, valuation and more — select the ones you need and watch the total update in real time. No fixed bundles: build your own.
Home.contactText: Our team is ready to answer your questions and help you choose the right services.

About.title: About us
About.intro: ImmoAdvisor was born from the hands-on experience of Carmine, a real estate professional active in Switzerland for years, who saw too many property owners pay for bloated, opaque service packages when selling their home. That's where the idea came from: a platform where you choose exactly the services you need — listing, photography, documentation, valuation — with no strings attached and the total always visible.
About.value1Text: Every service has a clear price, set before you buy. No surprises on the invoice.
About.value2Text: Choose only what you really need: not pre-packaged bundles, but a configurator built around your sale.
About.value3Text: Years of experience in the Swiss real estate market, for a service that truly understands local needs.
About.ctaText: Write to us, we're happy to help you choose the right services for your sale.

Contact.title: Contact us
Contact.subtitle: Have a question about our services, or want advice before you start? Write to us, we'll get back to you as soon as possible.
